stories.headline: Spain calls for government rules on AI
stories.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez said AI cannot be self-regulated and outlined a 12-month plan for responsible deployment, cybersecurity and an AI gigafactory. The roadmap is a policy proposal; implementation details remain limited.

stories.headline: China slows humanoid-robot IPO rush
stories.summary: Chinese regulators are informally raising scrutiny of humanoid-robot listings after Unitree shares fell 55% from their peak. Sources disagree on whether IPOs are effectively frozen or merely slowed; there is no formal ban.

stories.headline: US prepares sanctions against entire ICC
stories.summary: Sources say the Trump administration has prepared institution-wide sanctions that could sharply restrict US financial dealings with the ICC. No measure had been formally announced, and timing could change.

stories.headline: Putin’s party retains Russian supermajority
stories.summary: United Russia won 57.83% and 355 of 450 Duma seats with more than 95% counted, preserving its constitutional majority. Officials called the vote clean; exiled opposition activists alleged widespread fraud.

stories.headline: Iran and US trade threats after Houthi attacks
stories.summary: Iran warned that a major new US or allied attack would bring sustained retaliation; Washington issued a regional security alert. Claims about imminent action were not substantiated, and both sides also signaled limited openness to talks.
